args.title: Brightline Freight: Cold-chain logistics in 2026 — summary
args.body:
Combined summary of the Brightline Freight newsletter, its linked article, and the article's companion piece:

• Newsletter: Brightline Freight's latest newsletter spotlights cold-chain logistics in 2026, linking to a feature article on the topic (with a mirror option for charts).
• Article: Temperature excursions fell 30% where carriers shared live sensor data, and most of the savings came from fewer rejected loads rather than reduced spoilage.
• Companion piece: Cold-chain pilot programs cut claims by a quarter.
